description: This PHP class defines the WeeklyTimesheetPeriod which manages weekly timesheet periods, including calculating days within the period, setting the period and start date, and determining the local timezone based on client offsets. It extends a base class TimesheetPeriod and interacts with external context and XML data.

classes.name: WeeklyTimesheetPeriod
classes.description: A class representing a weekly timesheet period, allowing calculation of specific dates within the week and handling timezone conversions based on client offset.

methods.name: calculateDaysInTheTimesheetPeriod
methods.description: Calculates and returns the array of dates for the current timesheet period based on the current date and XML start date.

methods.name: setTimesheetPeriodAndStartDate
methods.description: Generates an XML snippet defining the timesheet period and its start date.

methods.name: getLocalTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone name corresponding to the client's timezone offset.
